# NVIDIA Dynamo 1.5.0 — an ALTERNATIVE serving path for Qwen3.8-27B, behind the LiteLLM router.
#
#   clients ─▶ litellm :4000 ─▶ dynamo-frontend :8000 (Rust HTTP + parsers) ─TCP─▶ dynamo-worker (vLLM 0.28.0)
#
# NOTHING EXISTING IS REWIRED. LiteLLM gets one NEW alias, `qwen3.8-27b-dynamo`, next to the
# existing `qwen3.8-27b-1m` (plain vLLM 0.27.1). Same checkpoint, same flags, so the two can be
# A/B'd through one router. Both want the same card, so they are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE:
#   scripts/use-model.sh qwen3.8-27b-dynamo     # stops vllm-qwen38, starts this
#   scripts/use-model.sh qwen3.8-27b-1m         # and back
#
# Generated 2026-09-23, unverified on a real GPU worker. What WAS checked (this image, this box):
#   - image pulled: nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/vllm-runtime:1.5.0 (20.1 GB), ai-dynamo 1.5.0,
#     vLLM 0.28.0, torch 2.13.0+cu130, get_device_capability() == (12, 0) on the Workstation card
#   - every flag below appears in `--help` of dynamo.frontend / dynamo.vllm in that image
#   - the frontend<->worker plumbing across two containers: `docker compose --profile mock up`
#     (CPU-only mocker, no VRAM) — see README.md for what it proved
# Not yet checked: that the NVFP4 Qwen3.8 weights load and answer under 0.28.0 on sm_120, and the
# parser choice on real tool calls. Do that with the README's "First real run".
#
# NO etcd / NATS. Discovery is the `file` backend: frontend and worker share DYN_FILE_KV on a
# named volume; the request plane is TCP. NATS is only needed for KV-event routing, which buys
# nothing with one worker (see README).
#
# DYNAMO SPEAKS ITS OWN DIALECT ON THE WORKER, not vLLM's flags: tool/reasoning parsing runs in the
# Rust frontend and is chosen by --dyn-tool-call-parser / --dyn-reasoning-parser on the WORKER.
# Passing vLLM's --tool-call-parser here does nothing useful. Qwen3.8 uses qwen3_coder (the XML tool
# format vLLM calls qwen3_xml) — CONFIRM on a real tool call before trusting it.
#
# THE PINNED SNAPSHOT IS LOADED BY PATH, not `--model <id> --revision <sha>`. Dynamo resolves the model
# through the HF cache's refs/main, which in the lab's shared cache points at a different revision
# (f0b7c9e…, metadata only) than the pin (16b6615…, the 22 GB one). By id it crash-loops with
# "Cannot find an appropriate cached snapshot folder ... outgoing traffic has been disabled".
# Measured 2026-09-23. Same reason the mocker takes the snapshot dir.
#
# Egress: none needed. HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 — the checkpoint is already in the shared cache.
name: ai-lab-dynamo

x-image: &image nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/vllm-runtime:1.5.0
x-common: &common
  image: *image
  # Rootless Docker: uid 0 in the container is this host user, so the shared HF cache is readable.
  # The image's default uid 1000 would map to a subuid that cannot read it.
  user: "0:0"
  entrypoint: []
  networks: [ai-lab]
  cap_drop: [ALL]
  security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
  restart: unless-stopped

services:
  dynamo-frontend:
    <<: *common
    command: ["python3", "-m", "dynamo.frontend", "--http-host", "0.0.0.0", "--http-port", "8000",
              "--discovery-backend", "file", "--request-plane", "tcp"]
    environment:
      DYN_FILE_KV: /dynamo-kv
      # Traces -> the lab's collector (Tempo/Phoenix/Langfuse), same bus name every other service uses.
      # Off until you flip it: the endpoint below is only reachable when observability/ is up.
      DYN_LOGGING_JSONL: "${DYN_LOGGING_JSONL:-false}"
      OTEL_EXPORT_ENABLED: "${OTEL_EXPORT_ENABLED:-false}"
      OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT: http://otel-collector:4317
      OTEL_SERVICE_NAME: dynamo-frontend
    volumes:
      - dynamo-kv:/dynamo-kv
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8020:8000"        # host loopback only; 8000 is taken by the vllm-* engines
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python3 -c \"import urllib.request as u;u.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health',timeout=3)\""]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    read_only: true
    # The frontend materialises each worker's model card (tokenizer, chat template) into
    # ~/.cache/dynamo before it will list the model. read_only:true without this = an EMPTY
    # /v1/models and a WARN "creating MDC blobs dir ... Read-only file system" on repeat.
    tmpfs: [/tmp, /home/dynamo/.cache]
    pids_limit: 512

  dynamo-worker:
    <<: *common
    command: >
      python3 -m dynamo.vllm
      --model /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--unsloth--Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4/snapshots/16b6615af3548b88e2d8e382457bc705b00479cf
      --served-model-name unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4
      --discovery-backend file
      --request-plane tcp
      --dyn-tool-call-parser qwen3_coder
      --dyn-reasoning-parser qwen3
      --dyn-enable-structural-tag
      --max-model-len ${CTX:-262144}
      --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2}'
      --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEM_UTIL:-0.50}
      --kv-cache-memory-bytes ${KV_CACHE_MEMORY:-20000000000}
      --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-64}
      --max-num-batched-tokens 8192
      --enable-chunked-prefill
      --enable-prefix-caching
    environment:
      # The image's HOME is /home/dynamo even for uid 0, so without this the flashinfer/vllm cache
      # volumes below (mounted at /root/.cache) are never used and every start recompiles.
      HOME: /root
      DYN_FILE_KV: /dynamo-kv
      DYN_SYSTEM_PORT: "8081"        # worker /metrics (+ engine metrics), scraped on the bus
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.0"
      CUTE_DSL_ARCH: "sm_120"
      FLASHINFER_NVCC_THREADS: "2"
      NVCC_THREADS: "2"
      MAX_JOBS: "4"
      OTEL_SERVICE_NAME: dynamo-worker
    volumes:
      - dynamo-kv:/dynamo-kv
      - /srv/models/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface
      - flashinfer-cache:/root/.cache/flashinfer
      - vllm-cache:/root/.cache/vllm
    ipc: host
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ["GPU-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"]   # Workstation Edition, same card as vllm-qwen38
              capabilities: [gpu]
    depends_on: [dynamo-frontend]

  # CPU-only stand-in worker to prove frontend<->worker discovery + routing with NO VRAM.
  # `docker compose --profile mock up -d` — never alongside dynamo-worker (same model name).
  # --model-path is the pinned SNAPSHOT DIR, not the repo id: the shared cache's refs/main points at
  # a different revision than the pin, so the id form fails "Model snapshots ... not found in cache".
  dynamo-mocker:
    <<: *common
    profiles: [mock]
    command: ["python3", "-m", "dynamo.mocker", "--model-path",
              "/root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--unsloth--Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4/snapshots/16b6615af3548b88e2d8e382457bc705b00479cf",
              "--model-name", "unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4", "--discovery-backend", "file", "--request-plane", "tcp"]
    environment:
      DYN_FILE_KV: /dynamo-kv
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"
    volumes:
      - dynamo-kv:/dynamo-kv
      - /srv/models/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface:ro
    depends_on: [dynamo-frontend]

volumes:
  dynamo-kv:
  flashinfer-cache:
  vllm-cache:

networks:
  ai-lab:
    external: true

# Generated by Nemo Console (ADR 8). The repo compose is never edited: delete this file to revert.
# Compose REPLACES `command` (it does not merge it), so the full argv is restated below; flags the
# console does not manage are carried over verbatim from the base compose.
# nemo-console-values: {"enable_prefix_caching":false,"gpu_memory_utilization":0.6,"max_model_len":131072,"num_speculative_tokens":3,"reasoning_parser":"none","router_mode":"kv"}
# WARNING: router_mode=kv needs more than one worker and NATS/ZMQ KV events from the workers; with the single worker (file discovery, no NATS) it adds a hop for nothing and may not route.
# WARNING: reasoning_parser=none: <think> text stays inline in content.
services:
  dynamo-worker:
    command:
      - "python3"
      - "-m"
      - "dynamo.vllm"
      - "--model"
      - "/root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--unsloth--Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4/snapshots/16b6615af3548b88e2d8e382457bc705b00479cf"
      - "--served-model-name"
      - "unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4"
      - "--discovery-backend"
      - "file"
      - "--request-plane"
      - "tcp"
      - "--dyn-tool-call-parser"
      - "qwen3_coder"
      - "--dyn-enable-structural-tag"
      - "--max-model-len"
      - "131072"
      - "--speculative-config"
      - "{\"method\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":3}"
      - "--gpu-memory-utilization"
      - "0.60"
      - "--kv-cache-memory-bytes"
      - "${KV_CACHE_MEMORY:-20000000000}"
      - "--max-num-seqs"
      - "${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-64}"
      - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
      - "8192"
      - "--enable-chunked-prefill"
      - "--no-enable-prefix-caching"
  dynamo-frontend:
    command:
      - "python3"
      - "-m"
      - "dynamo.frontend"
      - "--http-host"
      - "0.0.0.0"
      - "--http-port"
      - "8000"
      - "--discovery-backend"
      - "file"
      - "--request-plane"
      - "tcp"
      - "--router-mode"
      - "kv"
